title: French Onion Scalloped Potatoes
creator: Ashieeeats
cookTime: Caramelize onions at least 1 hour; bake 60-75 min at 350°F covered, then 20-30 min at 400°F uncovered; rest 20 min
ingredients: 5-6 medium yellow onions (~2 lbs), thinly sliced
3 lb Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Caramelized onions: In a pot on medium heat, melt the butter, then add onions and 2 big pinches of salt. Stir and cover for 10-15 min (stirring once or twice) until softened.

Uncover, reduce heat to med-low, and stir occasionally until deeply caramelized and soft. This will take at least an hour. Add a splash of water if anything starts to burn. At the last minute, add Worcestershire.
Scalloped potatoes: Starting in a cold pan, cook pancetta on medium heat until crisp. Remove and set aside. Leave 1 tbsp of fat in the pan.

In the same pan melt 2 tbsp butter, then saute minced garlic for 30 sec. Add flour. Whisk for 1-2 min to cook the flour. Gradually pour in warmed milk and cream, whisking until smooth and slightly thickened. Stir in fresh thyme, dijon, and a pinch of nutmeg. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Slice the potatoes into 1/8-inch slices just before assembling.

Lightly grease a 9x13 baking dish with butter. Spread a thin layer of sauce on the bottom. Build layers in this order: potatoes, caramelized onions, Gruyere, sauce (3 layers total). Finish the top sauce layer with remaining Gruyere and lots of freshly grated Parmesan.
Cover with parchment, then wrap tightly with aluminum foil.
Bake at 350F for 60-75 min until potatoes are tender. Uncover, turn the oven to 400F, and bake 20-30 min until golden brown and bubbly.
Top with crispy pancetta and fresh chives. Rest at least 20 min before serving.
notes: From an Ashieeeats Facebook reel (Big Back Kitchen Ep. 1), recipe taken from the on-screen caption. Not stated: servings and prep time. Pancetta is optional. Some caption text overlapped the video, so double-check quantities against the reel.
